title: One Week in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **The day you land decides the week.** It fixes where your Monday and your Sunday fall, and those two days shape the other five.

**Mondays:** every Museum Island museum, the Gemäldegalerie, Sanssouci and Charlottenburg Palace are closed. Give Monday to the **Berlin Wall**, whose outdoor memorial on Bernauer Straße is open every day.
**Sundays:** shops are shut, so Sunday goes to the **Mauerpark flea market** (10:00 to 18:00), never to the shopping day.
**Wednesdays from September to June:** a free lunch concert at the **Philharmonie** at 13:00, which is why City West sits on a Wednesday.
**Thursdays:** the Bode-Museum and the Neue Nationalgalerie stay open until 20:00, the best day for Museum Island.
**The Reichstag dome** is free with advance registration, last entry 21:45, and closed for cleaning **from 19 to 30 October 2026**.
**My move:** enter your arrival date in the board below, then book the dome, the Potsdam palace slot and my Berlin Then and Now walk before you fly.
